svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Metrics workbench with dual Y axes and time-shifted top X axis
svg.desc: Metrics workbench: metric browser, PromQL editor with syntax highlighting and an inline parse error at a byte offset, and a GPU line chart with a secondary Y axis (rps left, p99 right, coloured per series), a second X axis on top for the time-shifted comparison window 'last Tue' with a drag handle and 'Align on onset', a manual-range pin on the right axis, a crosshair tooltip reading every axis, and the progressive-data badge (⚡ local · ☁ server · ✓ exact).

g.text: hover a function for docs · Explain ▸ rollup, rows read, time
B = A − 7d 00:00:00 · drag top axis to slide
SERIES · sortable by max, last, anomaly
Inline error at a byte offset
Second X axis for B = last Tue
Own colour, real clock labels; drag
⠿ to slide B, or Align on onset.
Two Y axes, coloured per series
rps left (blue), p99 right (sand); ◧/◨ repeat it in legend + tooltip.
Manual range pin on the p99 axis
Wheel/drag an axis pins it; double-click the axis to fit again.
